Container.Name: CommandTable
Container.Overview: A Magic life counter for one device or shared rooms. Track one to eight players on a single phone, or create a shared room and invite friends by code, link or QR. Players join in a browser with no accounts. Shared games are kept in the Data folder.

Config.Name: App address
Config.Description: The exact address every phone will open, including the port, for example http://192.168.1.50:8080 or https://table.example.com.

Config.Name: Allow plain HTTP
Config.Description: Leave true for an http:// address on your home network. Set to false when App address is https://.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Shared rooms and guest sessions (SQLite). Keep this on a cache or array disk, not a network share.

Config.Name: Trusted proxy hops
Config.Description: Set to 1 when a reverse proxy sits in front of Command Table.
